title: Follow-up, neck, discharge to home program

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hi Ingrid. You're nearly done. How's the neck?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Pain is 1 out of 10 when I check my phone, and zero in the morning.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I sleep through the night now.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good. Rotation is 75 degrees to each side now, versus 60 at the start.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Deep neck flexor strength is 5/5 on the test.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Chin tucks feel easy now. I'm doing them about once a day.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: What are your daily activities like?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Gardening, driving, and I'm back at the computer for full days without stopping.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: That's great progress. Your goal was to finish the gardening season without stiffness. How is that?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Still tight after an hour of weeding, but it's better.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Assessment: the neck is much better, and the remaining stiffness is small. You're ready to move to a home program.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: I'm discharging you from weekly visits to a home program. Come back if the pain returns or you have new symptoms. No follow-up visit is scheduled.

expectedFacts.statement: Pain 1 out of 10 with phone, zero in morning
Still tight after an hour of weeding
Neck much better, small remaining stiffness
